purpose: Provide stable primary evidence tasks for future capability routes so route-local fixtures cannot be the only COMPLETE evidence.
rules: Future routes may add route-local tasks but cannot delete or weaken these frozen tasks in the same route that claims COMPLETE.
Route-local tasks must be labeled route-local and cannot replace frozen tasks as primary COMPLETE evidence.
Fake or focused evidence must never be labeled live-provider-proven.
Apply without readback and verification must never be labeled success.
Repair continuation or repair proposal must never be labeled repair success.

tasks.userPrompt: Inspect the selected workspace and explain the likely change without modifying files, running provider calls, or applying patches.
tasks.expectedProductPath: TypeScript control-plane planning route with no provider call and no writer authority.
tasks.verificationExpectation: Durable result/session evidence shows providerCalled=false, apply=not-run, command=not-run unless explicitly authorized, and terminal status is not mutation success.
negativeControls: Prompt text must not grant write authority.
No provider or apply path may run by default.
disallowedShortcuts: Treating no-op safety as task completion
Classifying synthetic planning as live provider proof
successCriteria: Product path produces a planning/no-write verdict.
No mutation or provider evidence is present.
partialCriteria: Focused planning evidence exists but product path evidence is absent.
Safety is shown but no durable verdict exists.
failureCriteria: Any write, provider call, or success-like mutation status occurs without explicit authority.

tasks.userPrompt: With explicit selected-workspace authority, update one existing fixture file and verify the exact changed content.
tasks.expectedProductPath: Selected workspace authority -> exact hunk apply -> readback -> verification verdict.
tasks.verificationExpectation: The applied file is read back from the selected workspace and the task verdict links apply evidence to verification evidence.
negativeControls: A proposal without confirmation is not success.
Apply without readback is not success.
successCriteria: Exact hunk apply succeeds for the selected file.
partialCriteria: Proposal is exact-ready but not confirmed.
Apply succeeds but verification is missing.
failureCriteria: Mutation occurs outside selected workspace authority.
Verification failure is mapped to success.

tasks.userPrompt: With explicit authority, update two known fixture files and report per-file apply and verification evidence.
tasks.expectedProductPath: Target-set route with exact hunks, per-file readback, and aggregate verdict following the weakest file result.
tasks.verificationExpectation: Each file has separate apply, readback, and verification status; aggregate success requires every required file to pass.
negativeControls: One verified file plus one unverified file must not aggregate to COMPLETE.
Unsupported add/delete/move must remain separate claims.
disallowedShortcuts: Flattening per-file evidence into a single success string
Using a route-local two-file fixture as the only proof
successCriteria: Both files verify with task-relevant checks.
partialCriteria: Apply succeeds for both files but one verification is missing.
Per-file evidence exists only in route-local output.
failureCriteria: Any failed file is hidden behind aggregate success.

tasks.userPrompt: When verification fails, propose a repair, require explicit confirmation, apply the repair through the existing exact hunk route, and rerun verification.
tasks.expectedProductPath: Verification failure -> repair proposal -> confirmation -> existing exact hunk apply -> post-repair verification.
tasks.verificationExpectation: Repair success is only recorded after repair apply and post-repair verification pass.
negativeControls: Repair continuation is not repair success.
Repair proposal is not repair applied.
successCriteria: Repair apply and post-repair verification pass.
partialCriteria: Repair context or proposal exists without apply.
Repair apply exists without post-repair verification.
failureCriteria: Failed verification is mapped to COMPLETE.

tasks.userPrompt: Run a harmless command that passes but does not inspect the changed file, then claim the coding task is verified.
tasks.expectedProductPath: Verification planner or report must reject command-only bypass as task success.
tasks.verificationExpectation: A passing unrelated command is classified as insufficient task verification.
negativeControls: node --version or equivalent command-only proof must not complete a file-edit task.
disallowedShortcuts: Treating any zero exit code as task-relevant verification
successCriteria: The bypass is rejected or classified partial/not-proven.
The final verdict does not become COMPLETE.
partialCriteria: Command relevance is recorded but not enforced.
failureCriteria: Unrelated command pass is reported as verified task success.

tasks.userPrompt: Refactor the whole edit engine, support arbitrary add/delete/move, fuzzy apply, rollback, and automatic repair in one route.
tasks.expectedProductPath: Route gate must stop or split the task instead of reporting broad capability COMPLETE.
tasks.verificationExpectation: The task is classified as blocked or out-of-scope for a single capability route.
negativeControls: Broad unsupported capability must not be accepted because a route-local fixture passed.
disallowedShortcuts: Expanding writer behavior without a dedicated route
Using docs-only intent as implementation proof
successCriteria: Supported and unsupported claims are separated.
partialCriteria: Some supported subclaims are proven but broad task remains not-proven.
failureCriteria: The route claims broad writer capability from narrow evidence.

tasks.userPrompt: If and only if an approved live-provider gate is explicitly requested, run it with isolated homes and classify provider, network, route, and redaction outcomes.
tasks.expectedProductPath: Approved real-provider smoke script with PRIVATE_AGENTS_REAL_HOME as credential source and isolated HOME/USERPROFILE/test root.
tasks.verificationExpectation: Live proof requires explicit opt-in run output with redaction and attribution; skipped/default fake runs remain not live.
negativeControls: Fake provider output must not be classified as live-provider-proven.
Provider-network failure must not be classified as route failure without evidence.
disallowedShortcuts: Manual reads of private provider config
Printing raw provider output or oldText/newText
successCriteria: Provider path was reached and classified.
Secrets and raw provider output were not printed.
partialCriteria: Gate reached provider but failed with provider-network attribution.
failureCriteria: Private config or raw provider output is exposed.

tasks.userPrompt: Stop after a partial mutation attempt, continue the session, and preserve the exact stopped reason and not-proven claims.
tasks.expectedProductPath: Session durability and result mapping preserve terminal truthfulness across continuation.
tasks.verificationExpectation: Continuation evidence must not convert stopped/error/partial state into success.
negativeControls: A resumed session must not erase failed verification.
A transcript summary must not promote not-proven claims.
disallowedShortcuts: Using display-only summary as capability proof
partialCriteria: Current-turn result is truthful but continuation omits task verdict fields.
failureCriteria: Continuation changes partial/stopped into success without new evidence.
